_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: A child will be born, and they will call him Emmanuel.
Restore us, O God; let your face shine.
He will be named Jesus, for he saves his people.
Come, let us worship the God who draws near.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Hold this name in your mouth like a promise: Emmanuel — God with us — the name given before the child was born.
We have prayed in the long dark, O Shepherd of Israel: turn your face toward us, let it shine, and bring us home.
An angel steadies a frightened man in his sleep: do not be afraid; name the child Jesus, for he will save.
The waiting is almost over; the One whose name means God-with-us is at the door.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: A child is coming; his name is God-with-us.
Turn your face toward us, Shepherd, and shine.
Do not be afraid; he comes to save.
